answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 70 identities per epoch. Audits are logged in nectar, queued in gale, and oasis publishes the wait time. A farm of 149 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3874 identities would post 4483 proofs and burn roughly 76 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
